The Release rule (GLOSSARY: Release, #299) as a table both of its copies are tested against, so they cannot drift apart: `releaseNameKey` and `mergeReleases` (`src/addon/kaijuSearch.ts`; `tests/unit/release-rule.test.ts`) and `quickcheck.release_key` and `same_release` (`tools/brain/quickcheck.py`, the indexer table's "Plays from a Release only it had"; `test_quickcheck.py`).

`table.tsv`, one pair of Sources per row: `a` and `size_a` (bytes; empty when the indexer gave none), `b` and `size_b`, `key_a` (`a`'s name as it is matched: lower case, spaces, `.`, `-` and `_` gone) and `same` (`yes` when the two are one Release: the same key and both sizes known and at most 1 % apart, of the larger). The names and sizes are NinjaCentral's and DrunkenSlug's real answers in `tests/fixtures/indexer-answers/`, except the row with spaces and `_` (the key's separators) and the row with no size. A change to the rule changes this table and both copies.
